### McGraw Hill Integrates Trusted K-12 Curriculum into Anthropic’s Claude for Teachers


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-Integrates-Trusted-K-12-Curriculum-into-Anthropics-Claude-for-Teachers-2026.pdf)


New agentic AI integration will give educators using Claude for Teachers the ability to access the McGraw Hill curriculum they use in the classroom to create personalized instructional materials for their students


**Key Highlights:**


- **Connecting to trusted curriculum through Claude for Teachers:** McGraw Hill is working with Anthropic to become one of the first major K-12 core curriculum providers to make its proprietary content available to school district customers through Claude for Teachers.
- **Helping teachers personalize high-quality instructional materials for their classroom:** Educators will be able to securely access trusted McGraw Hill curriculum through Claude for Teachers using a Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector to create lesson plans, learning tools and other personalized resources grounded in McGraw Hill’s pedagogical approach.
- **Advancing agentic AI in education:** The Claude for Teachers integration builds on McGraw Hill’s broader teacher-centric AI strategy, reflecting the company’s focus on responsible, safe and secure uses of AI that make its trusted curriculum available through the platforms teachers use, expanding the learning markets the company serves.


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK–12, higher education and professional learning, today announced a new collaboration with Anthropic to make its trusted K-12 curriculum available to McGraw Hill’s school district customers within Claude for Teachers. Using the MCP (Model Context Protocol) standard for AI, Claude for Teachers will enable educators to securely access their licensed McGraw Hill curriculum resources to create lesson plans, learning tools and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of their students.


Educators will be able to use Claude for Teachers with the McGraw Hill curriculum their district is implementing, helping teachers create and adapt instructional materials grounded in the high-quality curriculum already supporting teaching and learning in their classrooms.


The collaboration will make McGraw Hill one of the first major K-12 core curriculum providers to connect its proprietary content with Claude for Teachers. Claude for Teachers, introduced by Anthropic in July, provides verified U.S. K–12 educators with free access to Claude alongside connectors to evidence-based curricula and other education tools. McGraw Hill’s[TeachFX, an AI-native instructional coaching platform that the company acquired in September,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Fnews-insights%2Fpress-releases%2Fmcgraw-hill-acquires-teachfx-expanding-commitment-to-great-teaching-with-ai-coaching-tool-designed-by-educators.html&esheet=54635790&newsitemid=20261104013238&lan=en-US&anchor=TeachFX%2C+an+AI-native+instructional+coaching+platform+that+the+company+acquired+in+September%2C&index=1&md5=a0d56b6a60db69862269c7b191e4c77a) is already part of the Claude for Teachers ecosystem.


The launch marks another step in how McGraw Hill is shaping agentic AI for education by making its trusted content, created by world-class authors and grounded in proven pedagogy, available through trusted AI agents. As AI evolves from general-purpose models toward more specialized experiences, teachers will be able to operate in a secure environment to adapt their instructional materials, support teaching needs, and personalize learning in real time, while McGraw Hill protects the value of its content, authors and learning solutions.


“AI has tremendous potential to support teachers when it is integrated with the trusted curriculum educators are already using every day,” said Jana Thompson, President of McGraw Hill’s School group. “Our work with Anthropic complements our core business, helping us meet teachers where they are and giving them greater flexibility in how they engage with our content in a way that maintains curriculum coherence and quality. At the same time, it demonstrates how we can use emerging AI platforms to extend our reach, increase our impact, and create new avenues for growth.”


The collaboration reflects McGraw Hill’s broader approach to help schools use AI responsibly and effectively, extending the company’s work to embed AI-powered capabilities like Teacher Assistant, Writing Assistant and TeachFX within its own products, while also securely enabling its trusted curriculum to work effectively with the technology ecosystems schools and educators choose to use. Learn more about McGraw Hill’s focus on ensuring that AI-supported teaching remains grounded in high-quality instructional content, learning science and the needs of educators and students in our Trust Center:[https://www.mheducation.com/about-us/trust-center/our-ai-approach.html](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Ftrust-center%2Four-ai-approach.html&esheet=54635790&newsitemid=20261104013238&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Ftrust-center%2Four-ai-approach.html&index=2&md5=2ad3b04efcd1bfaea4a53e0cc5c44d6d)


The launch of the McGraw Hill learning agent in Claude for Teachers is one part of McGraw Hill’s work with Anthropic to improve the teaching and learning experience. The company also recently announced the selection of Claude as an enterprise AI productivity solution to help its employees build AI fluency, accelerate learning and work more effectively across the organization.


School districts interested in participating in McGraw Hill’s Claude for Teachers beta test can visit[https://www.mheducation.com/about-us/campaigns/ai-connector-beta.html](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Fcampaigns%2Fai-connector-beta.html&esheet=54635790&newsitemid=20261104013238&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Fcampaigns%2Fai-connector-beta.html&index=3&md5=1f2099b4b39790be41518b9d4bb27909) for more information.


**About McGraw Hill**


McGraw Hill (NYSE: MH) is a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, supporting the evolving needs of millions of educators and students around the world. We provide trusted, high-quality content and personalized learning experiences that use data, technology and learning science to help students progress towards their goals. Through our commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and belonging, we are dedicated to improving outcomes and access to education for all. We have over 30 offices across North America, Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and South America, and make our learning solutions available in more than 80 languages.
